note: Expected values come from the claim under test (IRIS semantics the IPM design relies on, as stated in A2 operation-inventory section 0 and the IPM class docs), not from observing IRIS. A null expect is an observation without a claim.

N-P01.claim: A full TROLLBACK reverts a journaled global set at $TLEVEL=1 in the namespace database.

inside.data.source: IRIS: a process reads its own uncommitted sets

N-P02.claim: TROLLBACK 1 at $TLEVEL=2 undoes only the innermost level and leaves $TLEVEL=1.

after1.tlevel.source: A2 P-4; Utils/Module.cls:1358-1362 rolls back one level per iteration

N-P03.claim: An inner TCOMMIT at $TLEVEL=2 only decrements $TLEVEL and is not durable if the outer level rolls back.

after.outer.rollback.L2.data.source: A2 P-4; intent 2.3 'Inner tcommit is not durable'

N-P04.claim: Sets to ^IRIS.Temp* (IRISTEMP) are not undone by TROLLBACK or TROLLBACK 1.

N-P05.claim: $INCREMENT is not undone by TROLLBACK, so a %IPM.General.History insert that is rolled back is gone and leaves an ID gap.

N-P06.claim: ^IRIS.Temp* globals are one instance-wide store visible from every namespace; namespace-database globals are not.

sys.userglobal.data.source: USER database global not mapped to %SYS

N-P07.claim: With process journaling disabled by %IPM.Utils.JournalManager (the NoJournal path), a TROLLBACK cannot revert global sets because rollback reads the journal; the flag is restored when the manager goes out of scope.

after.rollback.data.source: claim under test (no IPM or IRIS source in the inputs states it)

N-P08.claim: %OnClose runs when the last reference to an object is dropped, not when an earlier reference is dropped.
maps_to: AbstractHistory.cls:6-7 'persisted ... when the object falls out of scope'

N-P09.claim: %OnClose runs while an exception unwinds the frame holding the only reference, before the caller's CATCH block runs, including through a catch-and-rethrow frame (the Main:Load pattern).

N-P10.claim: %OnClose does not run when a JOBbed process holding the object is terminated with $SYSTEM.Process.Terminate.

closed.source: brief task 1; intent INT-HIST-03 ('A process that dies mid-action leaves a record with an empty end time')

N-P11.claim: At a normal HALT, %OnClose runs for objects still referenced by local variables.

N-P12.claim: IRIS rolls back the open transaction of a process terminated with $SYSTEM.Process.Terminate; its IRISTEMP sets stay.

dirty.read.data.source: IRIS reads are not isolated from other processes' uncommitted sets

N-P13.claim: The %IPM.General.History Finalized trigger allows edits of unfinalized rows, rejects object save and SQL UPDATE of finalized rows, and allows DELETE.

N-P14.claim: With the product HistoryTemp, setters update only the IRISTEMP row; the durable twin keeps its Init values until %OnClose, where a deep %Save of the swizzled PersistedTwin finalizes it, and the temp row is deleted.

N-P15.claim: Observation only: deleting the durable twin of an in-progress log before %OnClose (intent 3.4 'unspecified').

N-P16.claim: Once the twin is finalized, a second PersistToTwin (explicit call or the later %OnClose, the self-uninstall path) cannot change it, and %OnClose still deletes the temp row without raising.

N-P17.claim: The %IPM_General.HistoryTemp table read from another namespace returns IRISTEMP rows created by a process in USER.
